title: Lesson: Scope creep from variant addition added 6 weeks to Crest timeline
content:
Project: Crest | Gate: G3 | Function: OCM | Risk: Yes

WHAT HAPPENED
At G3 on Project Crest, Categories requested the addition of a second fragrance variant to the launch scope. The request was accepted without a formal impact assessment. The additional variant required new R&D formulation work, a second packaging dieline and artwork, and additional procurement activity. The cumulative effect added six weeks to the overall project timeline and ~€85K to the project cost.

IMPACT
- Six-week delay to G4 and knock-on delay to launch
- Budget overrun of €85K (7% above approved budget)
- Team morale impacted by rework across R&D and Packaging

LESSON
Any scope change request at or after G3 must be subject to a formal impact assessment covering timeline, cost, and resource before acceptance. The impact assessment must be presented at a governance board and require explicit approval before the scope change is incorporated into the plan.

RECOMMENDATION
Introduce a formal scope change request process with a mandatory impact assessment template. No scope changes to be accepted after G3 without governance board approval. Update BLAST standards to include scope change governance.
